scoring: tngsight-score/2; V=u+v_sys; web 1 km/s; R_eval per band; vwin=400

generation.ion_table: CLOUDY c17.03 FG11 + Rahmati13 self-shielding (THOR tables)
generation.grid: SBI log-lambda resampled by velocity to linear lambda, line offset removed

galaxy.disk_frame_source: BCG stellar PCA (r < 50 kpc, 119359 stars, tracer=stars_pca_50kpc)

spectra_source.label: THOR Voronoi + CLOUDY FG11 multiphase ICM pass
spectra_source.text: Structure-targeted 120-ray multiphase ICM library per galaxy cluster (40 coronal X-ray O VII / Ne VIII filaments, 35 warm-hot O VI / N V / C IV ram-pressure stripped tails, 30 cool-core BCG / jellyfish / satellite subhalo clumps, 15 virial cavity baseline rays) across impact parameters b <= 4000 kpc (+-4 Mpc). Ionisation: CLOUDY FG11 UV/X-ray background tables (THOR, Byrohl & Nelson 2025) with Rahmati et al. (2013) H I self-shielding and Springel & Hernquist (2003) eEOS cold-phase reconstruction; FP64 Voigt optical depths at 0.5 km/s over +-1500 km/s (default R X-ray = 3,000, dv = 100 km/s; R UV/EUV = 30,000, dv = 10 km/s).
spectra_source.ion_model: CLOUDY FG11 + Rahmati13 + SH03 eEOS cold phase (THOR)
spectra_source.cubes: 5-level 256^3 3D ICM cubes (+-4 Mpc L0 down to +-15 kpc L4 BCG core)
spectra_source.weights: Structure-targeted 120-ray multiphase ICM sightline library (b <= 4000 kpc)

selection.description: Direct THOR (thor-generic.sif) 3D Voronoi raytracing in 9+8 CLOUDY FG11 ion passes with SBI_CGM FP64 Voigt profiles across the halo cutout domain.
